reviews.text: Danilla took great care of my kittens! The service was excellent, she sent me videos and photos and left everything spotlessly clean for them. They loved her and relaxed quickly with her. I will definitely call her again!

Danilla is a wonderful professional. My cats were calm, and so was I, because they were so lovingly cared for. Every day Danilla sent photos and videos of her taking care of them. I can only thank her for her kindness. That's priceless.
I recommend her. I traveled for two weeks and she took extremely good care of my cat.

Excellent experience. Dani provided exceptional service in my home. She visited my cat, took care of her, cleaned all her food bowls daily, and cleaned the litter box. Furthermore, she sent photos every day, which made me feel very comfortable with her service. Most importantly, she loves animals, and that's clear.

Excellent service, I completely trust Dani's work; she took great care of my cats during my trip. She's someone I can count on; I have complete confidence in her work. Thank you so much for everything, Dani, God bless you!
Wonderful! Dani is an excellent professional, you can trust her. I was away for 10 days and felt completely at ease. My children were very well cared for. I loved it and highly recommend her.

I found Dani's service through the internet.
My pet daughters stayed with her for a week. The experience was super positive, they adapted well and seemed calm and comfortable.
Dani gave me daily updates, giving me peace of mind. She also followed all the instructions I gave her.
I can only thank her!

I found Dani through Google and she took great care of my cats, always sending photos and videos of them and ensuring a clean and organized environment while I was traveling. I loved the experience and will definitely hire her again when I travel! I recommend her 🧡 …

Dani was wonderful and dedicated, from the initial phone call to the in-home visit. It was my first experience, and I confess I was nervous, both about leaving the cats, who are new and recently rescued from the shelter, and about leaving someone in my house while we were away. But everything went well, and the photos she sent showed how comfortable they were; she even gave them affection when she arrived 🥰. When I got home, they were super calm, with full bellies, and happy not to have been alone. Whenever I need to, I'll run to Dani again, haha! I've already scheduled my next visits ❤️

Dani is very helpful with our four-legged babies, providing the attention and affection that is essential for them, whether it's with food, medication, walks, and care. I needed her boarding service and traveled with greater peace of mind. For me, affection and care come first, since they are away from their family environment. I highly recommend her pet sitting services.

I highly recommend Dani's work. Excellent communication before and during visits, always concerned about the hygiene and well-being of the pets (two dogs and a cat). Furthermore, I felt very relaxed while traveling, receiving photos and feedback on what was happening.
Very caring and helpful! Thank you 🫶🏼 …

I'm speechless with gratitude for the care she gave my little ones! Besides being incredibly attentive, she detailed the entire visit and put my mind at ease while I was traveling. Without a doubt, on future trips, I'll definitely leave our babies with Danilla! ❤️

Dani was super attentive to my dogs; from the first contact they got along really well. Besides the care she gave Zoe and Arthemis, she always kept in touch with photos and updates on how they were doing. Without a doubt, an excellent professional! ❤️
She took care of my elderly, paraplegic dog in a way that was more than professional...she loves what she does...and our four-legged friends love Dani too.
